 Test Procedure TP-17 - 900 s Controller Demonstration

     Revision            C
     Date                   03 Apr 2026
     Status                  Released
     Test object             PLC-101 sequence behavior

 1. Objective
 Verify the two-tank controller normal sequence, STOP/START resume behavior and controlled SHUT
 behavior in a 900 s simulation.
 2. Test Setup

      Item                                       Value
         Initial T1 level                                0.05 m
         Initial T2 level                                0.05 m
      Simulation duration                        900 s
      Logging interval                          1 s
      Configuration authority                      Approved requirements + DR-02 + CR-004
 3. Operator Command Schedule

     Time (s)       Command          Expected immediate controller response
     20           START             Begin or resume automatic operation; first occurrence begins T1 fill.
     220         STOP              Close all three valves and hold sequence context.
     280          START           Resume the state interrupted at 220 s.
     650         STOP              Close all valves; hold sequence context.
     700         SHUT               Enter controlled shutdown, inhibit V1, and command V2 and V3 open until both
                                           tanks are at low level.
 4. Acceptance Criteria
 AC-01 - T1 shall reach the effective high-level setpoint of 0.80 m before the first transfer begins.
 AC-02 - All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 220 s until the START command at 280 s.
 AC-03 - The START at 280 s shall resume the interrupted transfer rather than restart filling.
 AC-04 - Following completion of the first T2 drain, the controller shall automatically begin another fill cycle after the
       effective 8 s inter-cycle delay.
 AC-05 - All valves shall be closed throughout the STOP interval from 650 s until SHUT at 700 s.
 AC-06 - At 700 s V1 shall remain closed and V2/V3 shall be commanded open together for controlled draining.
 AC-07 - After shutdown drain completion the controller shall return to IDLE with all valves closed and shall remain
      there through 900 s because no subsequent START is scheduled.
 AC-08 - Normal automatic operation shall never command V1 and V2 simultaneously, nor V2 and V3 simultaneously.
     The latter combination is permitted only in SHUTDOWN.
 5. Expected State Timing Guidance
 Exact threshold transition timestamps depend on numerical integration and event ordering. A tolerance of
 +/-2 s is acceptable for state-boundary comparisons when the effective parameter set is used. The provided
 CSV is the benchmark trace generated with 1 s logging.
